svg.title: Three-Node Spatial Evidence Chain
svg.desc: Three provisional yards connect ordinary human route, public status and consent, a bounded service window, human handover or stop, and restored ordinary use. Not a road, red-line or deployment drawing.

g.text: CONCEPTUAL SPATIAL EVIDENCE · provisional markers / functional bands · not roads, red lines, permits or deployment
PROV-KEY-001 · AV-02 / 04 / 05 / 10 / 11 · site, fire/energy, responsibility and access evidence precede a window
PROV-KEY-002 · AV-01 / 08 / 09 / 12 · paper, phone, human entry and withdrawal remain first-class
PROV-KEY-003 · AV-03 / 06 / 07 · rail arrival, quiet walking, loading and event-day human routes are separated
STOP: missing evidence, blocked access chain or unverified takeover → stop / clear / restore ordinary route
STOP: no equivalent human service, consent, access or offline appeal → no expansion
STOP: missing station, fire, crowd, weather or emergency route evidence → human daily use only
